reason: Complete Mononofu Ruby-aware Bolmeteus search and exact Musha attack shield removal, actual B Crimson deck evolution/Fire Bird shield inspection and trigger-card destination, and Royal Dorian physical top-card mass devolution.
validationNotes: Start/post-verification actual nameKey counts9350/9353. Baseline01ecacf5. All9350 original card definitions, existing IDs, catalogue/details, aliases, image references, pin definitions and save formats preserved. Three reference rows added, not two; initial invariant fixture count corrected after inspecting the exact diff.

All three whole official faces, stats, original art, current limits and mana verified. Two exact Dorian reprints reviewed, five official images total; no reprint or ruby counted as an additional name.

Exact QA40784 reproduced with actual fully registered B Crimson from both player seats: Mononofu finds Bolmeteus ruby without changing the canonical name or ID. Optional creature-only search reveals the chosen card and shuffles even when declined. Initial missing reveal flag corrected in manifest, pins and live definition; both seats pass.

Mononofu exact original Musha watcher excludes Bui and the opposing player, works on a creature attack and puts one complete shield group into its owners grave without declaring a trigger or counting a break. Suppressed source does not trigger.

Crimson uses existing paid single-card deck evolution; creature top becomes physical base, noncreature stays on top and same Crimson returns to hand while mana remains paid. Own Fire Bird shield breaks inspect privately; S-trigger cards go to grave and nontriggers to hand. Actual break counters/Swan triggers remain, including mixed multi-card bundles and an actual Genmu-ignored Fire Bird.

Private Crimson inspection uses the existing inspectedCards actor-only projection and encrypted serializable task. Initial online assertions used the wrong field; corrected to inspectedCards, absent for the defender. No private shield names are added to the public log.

Extra Shield Saver regression exposed a real new continuation bug: after inspection the entire break pipeline offered a previously declined saver again. Added a narrow native commit continuation after inspection; never re-enters prior replacement/guard choices. Both seats accept/decline Saver, preserve saved shields, conserve physical IDs and retain Neme first-break replacement. All22 affected Crimson cases rechecked after this fix.

Royal Dorian snapshots both players evolution creatures, moves only each original top to its actual owners mana and reconstructs through the native movement path. Bases, no-base NEO, untargetable, sealed, changed control, actual Star and shield-trigger entry verified. Current rule801.4 reproduced with a nonindependent spell discarded before a tapped creature remains; no new entry draw occurs and an exposed evolution is not removed a second time.

46 distinct focused cases and253 affected regressions pass,total299. Initial6 failures were resolved (2 reveal-definition failures,4 fixture assertions); extra2 Saver continuation failures were corrected in code. Legal40-card seeded game finishes with80 conserved physical IDs and JSON-equivalent legal actions. Check/audit/target9500/nameKey/invariants pass.

Historical whole npm test remains interrupted/unconfirmed; all individual, long, reprint and user deferrals preserved. Mononofu phase1704 hold is resolved by this full batch. No push/publication/Netlify update.
